sentences.speaker: Vinny Gambini
sentences.text: Miss Vito, with your extensive experience in automotive mechanics, could you explain the tire tracks found at the Sac-O-Suds convenience store?

sentences.speaker: Mona Lisa Vito
sentences.text: The tire marks left by the getaway vehicle show two distinct dual-track markings made by a car with an independent rear suspension and a positraction differential.

sentences.speaker: Mona Lisa Vito
sentences.text: A 1964 Buick Skylark, which the defendants were driving, has a solid rear axle and could never make those symmetrical marks.

sentences.speaker: Prosecutor Jim Trotter
sentences.text: Objection your honor, this testimony is speculative and uncorroborated by state forensics.

sentences.speaker: Judge Chamberlain Haller
sentences.text: Overruled, the witness has qualified as an expert in automotive mechanics and will continue.

sentences.speaker: Mona Lisa Vito
sentences.text: Only two cars made by General Motors had that specific track width and independent suspension: the 1963 Pontiac Tempest and the Chevrolet Corvette.

sentences.speaker: Prosecutor Jim Trotter
sentences.text: In light of this ballistic and mechanical evidence, the State respectfully moves to dismiss all charges against the defendants.
